title: Software Developer – AI/ML
intro: I build LLM agents and machine-learning tools in Python, from a labelled dataset to automation running in daily production.

bullets: Designed and built an agentic NOC Auto-Responder: the agent reads device-down alerts over IMAP, calls **3 tools** (site directory, manager lookup, live weather API) and drafts notifications with Gemini.
Added a rule-based template fallback so the agent never drops an alert when the LLM fails or times out.
Applied detection logic and threat-intel APIs (VirusTotal, AbuseIPDB) to classify and prioritise **30–40 events a day (~700 a month)**.
Automated repetitive operations across **4 enterprise platforms** (ServiceNow, CrowdStrike, Google SecOps, Entra ID) with Python and PowerShell.
Analysed log data with Google SecOps queries to find patterns behind recurring incidents and traced them to **3 root causes**.

achievements: Cut alert handling from **~15 to ~3 minutes (80% faster)** with the LLM-powered auto-responder.
Replaced **~30 minutes of manual work with a ~3-minute automated run (90% faster)** for bulk account operations.

bullets: Built web app features with Node.js, React and MongoDB.
Completed paid usability and feedback tests evaluating websites and applications, providing structured, detailed feedback under platform confidentiality terms.
Completed **25+ tests**, maintaining a consistent quality and completion record.
Built and labelled a text dataset, trained a TF-IDF + Logistic Regression classifier and tuned it over 15 rounds to **98.5% precision and recall**.
Served via FastAPI to a Chrome extension that blocks sensitive data from AI chat tools.
Tool-using agent in daily production use.
**80% faster** alert handling with zero missed alerts.
Built and security-tested a web app.
